About Watsons Malaysia

Watsons is Asia’s leading health and beauty retailer, currently operating over 15,000 stores and more than 1,500 pharmacies across 13 Asian and European markets. With a promise to customers – LOOK GOOD, Feel GREAT – Watsons goes the extra mile, bringing smiles to people’s faces and providing the best of health, wellbeing, beauty, and personal care in their stores and online.

 

How the Watsons Malaysia Affiliate Program Works

Affiliates can earn a commission of up to 2.10% on sales across all categories. The program operates on a cost-per-sale (CPS) model, rewarding affiliates for every successful sale through their tracking link. The cookie period for tracking conversions is set at 24 hours. However, it's essential to note that e-vouchers are non-commissionable.

 

Benefits of joining the Watsons Malaysia affiliate program

 

Diverse Offerings: From health to beauty products, promote a wide range of offerings from Watsons.

Competitive Commissions: Earn up to 4% commission on sales, making it one of the more rewarding affiliate programs in the health and beauty sector.

Global Brand Recognition: Featuring a globally recognized brand like Watsons adds credibility to your promotions.

Support and Tools: With Involve Asia managing the program, affiliates can access a range of promotional tools and support.

 

Review of the Watsons Malaysia Affiliate program

The Watsons Malaysia Affiliate Program, managed by Involve Asia, reflects Watsons' commitment to collaboration and growth. With a clear commission structure, support from Involve Asia, and the opportunity to promote a wide range of health and beauty products, it's a top choice for those looking to venture into affiliate marketing in the health and beauty sector.

  • Promotes or is related to illegal activities (illegal drugs, phishing, terrorism, criminal activities, contests, pyramid schemes, or chain letters).
  • Promotes or is related to tobacco, gambling, or weapons.
  • Is related to pornographic or obscene material.
  • Is related to excessively graphic or explicit violence.
  • Is defamatory, inappropriate, or profane.
  • Is discriminatory or constitutes “hate speech”, whether directed at an individual or a group, and whether based upon the race, sex, creed, national origin, religious affiliation, sexual orientation, or language of such individual or group.
  • Promotes or contains viruses, worms, corrupted files, malware, cracks, or other materials that are intended to or may damage or render inoperable software, hardware, or security measures.

Affiliate should not, and will not allow any third party to:

  • Use own affiliate link and converting for yourself might lead to non-commissionable conversions;
  • Use advertising e-mails to promote Shopee without Shopee’s prior written consent;
  • Use robots or other automated query tools, computer-generated search requests;
  • Fraudulent use of search engine optimization services to generate or conceal impressions, inquiries, clicks, or conversions
    that are fraudulent or invalid;
  • Drive or utilise any SEM keywords and other keyword-based advertising traffic using the Shopee brand or private labels to Shopee’s Platform (in other words, "Shopee" and other similar words which could be misleading as Shopee must be entered as a negative keyword) without Shopee’s prior written consent;
  • Use any automated means or form of scraping, or other data extraction methods to access, query, collect, or use Shopee intellectual property, including logo, key visuals, creative materials and other Confidential Information from the Platform or otherwise;
  • Apply Affiliate Links or advertise Affiliate Media through any of Shopee’s social media channels or the social media channels of any Shopee’s Sellers/other affiliates to hijack traffic;
  • Apply Affiliate Links on Affiliate Media that contains Prohibited Content, or in torrent or streaming sites;
  • (Where Affiliate is an affiliate network) Re-brokering to another affiliate network as their sub-affiliate; or
  • Incorporate any lottery or lucky draw in the Affiliate Media.
  • Post random, irrelevant content that is not meant to promote the items/shops (including, but not limited to fake promotion, Entertainment news, clickbait product reviews etc).
